description: Attach (or refresh, e.g. after rescheduling) a Google Meet or Microsoft Teams video link on an existing meeting, via the tenant's connected integration (Integrations page). Required: meeting_id, provider ('google_meet'|'teams'). Re-calling with the same provider updates the SAME underlying video meeting (in place) rather than creating a new one — safe to call again after update_meeting changes the time. Teams without Microsoft 365: falls back to the Teams web bridge on the host's computer (video_link_source 'bridge'); this tool NEVER invites anyone through the bridge, it only stores the link, and a bridge link is not moved on a re-call (change the time in Teams). Returns { ok, provider, video_link, video_link_source?, gcal_event_id? | teams_meeting_id? }; throws with both ways to fix it if no Teams route works.

teams_account.description: Teams via bridge only: which Teams account on the host's computer. Default: its default account.

name: add_meeting_video_link
